summary_1line: After honoring Jatayu, Rama and Lakshmana encounter the demoness Ayomukhi and the monstrous Kabandha while searching the forest for Sita.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama offers balls of deer flesh on fresh green grass as an oblation to the fallen vulture king Jatayu in the quiet forest.
Lakshmana slices off the ears and nose of the hideous demoness Ayomukhi as she flees screaming into the dark forest.
The gigantic headless demon Kabandha, with a mouth in his belly and a single eye in his chest, stretches his enormous arms to seize Rama and Lakshmana.
